recipe.title: Assign vans to overlapping healthcare supply deliveries
recipe.scenario: Assign vans to three overlapping deliveries of cartons, lab consumables, and protective equipment. Use fictional receiving sites and no patient data or clinical decisions. A van must cover the full receiving window and carry the job's weight. This example does not model aggregate capacity, linked pickup-before-delivery route ordering, multi-stop routing, or handling requirements beyond weight and availability.

field.name: job-names
field.description: Jobs in input order: Clinic cartons, Lab consumables, Care center PPE. The names and data are synthetic.

field.name: job-weights-kg
field.description: Whole kilograms per shipment, in job order: 90,280,150.

field.name: job-windows-minutes
field.description: Receiving start and end pairs in minutes after midnight on one day: 480,510; 485,520; 490,530. All three intervals overlap.

field.name: vehicle-names
field.description: Vans in zero-based index order: Cargo van, Compact van, Courier van, East van.

field.name: vehicle-capacities-kg
field.description: Per-vehicle usable load limits in whole kilograms: 400,120,250,450.

field.name: vehicle-windows-minutes
field.description: Availability start and end pairs in minutes after midnight: 450,560; 470,520; 475,550; 490,535.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Precomputed job and vehicle index pairs from full window containment and per-job capacity: 0,0; 0,1; 0,2; 1,0; 2,0; 2,2; 2,3. The solver receives these as assignment domains and does not recompute them from weights or windows.

field.name: preferred-care-center-vehicle
field.description: Optional vehicle index preferred for Care center PPE. The example prefers East van, index 3. A preference never overrides eligibility or overlap.

field.name: assigned-vehicles
field.description: For a feasible result, one vehicle index per job in input order. With the example preference, the first optimal result is 1,0,3.
